pairs.question: Who threw fewer career touchdown passes?
pairs.fact: Tom Brady threw 649 regular-season touchdown passes, plus 88 more in the playoffs.

pairs.question: Who hit more career home runs?
pairs.fact: San Francisco's McCovey Cove is named after him.

pairs.question: Which movie won more Oscars?
pairs.fact: Three films share the record of 11 Oscars: Ben-Hur, Titanic and The Return of the King.

pairs.question: Which is smaller?
pairs.fact: Wrangell–St. Elias, the biggest US national park, is larger than nine US states.

pairs.question: Which had more people in the 2020 census?
pairs.fact: Alaska has the lowest population density of any state.

pairs.question: Which city gets less rain each year?
pairs.fact: Hilo, Hawaii averages about 120 inches of rain a year, wetter than any big mainland US city.

pairs.question: Which element was discovered more recently?
pairs.fact: Hennig Brand discovered phosphorus in 1669 while boiling down urine, looking for gold.

pairs.question: Which college has more undergraduates?
pairs.fact: Texas A&M has more undergraduates than any other US campus, over 50,000.

pairs.question: Which airport is busier?
pairs.fact: Atlanta has been the world's busiest airport by passengers almost every year since 1998.

pairs.question: Which Broadway show ran for more performances?
pairs.fact: The Phantom of the Opera played 13,981 performances over 35 years, the longest run in Broadway history.
